The Nov 11 trip and departure manifest are immutable regression fixtures for the legacy Hakone, Atami, direct-service and station-logo scenarios. They are not shipped as the active itinerary. Current plan geography, dates, timing and browser rendering are covered by tokyo-detailed-plan.test.cjs, tokyo-timetables.test.cjs and detailed-plan-browser.cjs. Historic stored prices in these fixtures are not current quotes.
